name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state and design-ratification state) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.57.2 — plugin code sweep (specs/20260902/02-plugin-code-sweep.md): every whole-line comment under `spec/scripts`, `spec/bin`, `scripts`, and `tests` now states the current invariant plus one owner id (spec path, AC-ID, D-number, ADR, or run id) — the standing scan holds the code group at zero findings and the tracked `.claude/comment-narration.baseline.json` shrinks to prose-only paths, with `comment-narration.js --code-identical <diff_base>` as the executed oracle proving no executable line moved. `spec-build-driver.js`'s `handleTestsAuthored` now expands a tests-layer File Plan glob row (e.g. `tests/**/*.test.js`) through the shared `lib/glob-match.js` instead of checking it as a literal filename — the same matcher `red-check.js` and `scope-reconcile.js` already use — fixing a defect that blocked every spec whose tests-layer row is a glob pattern from ever leaving TESTS. 7.57.1 — design-stage hand-off block restored (`spec/commands/design.md` § Step 5): the human look prints the four-anchor block the retired design driver used to print — 🎨 the catalog command to run, 🔗 one line per bound story with the catalog search keyword and the deep link derived from `design.render.url`'s `{story}` placeholder, 🆕 components changed this run, 👀 one line per component on what to look for, 📄 the gate report path — every value derived from disk, never asked; a change round re-prints it scoped to what the round touched. `tests/design-look-handoff.test.js` pins the anchors and their disk sources. 7.57.0 — comment narration gate (specs/20260902/01-comment-narration-gate.md): `comment-narration.js` classifies whole-line comments and prose against six narration classes and ratchets against a tracked per-file baseline that only shrinks; `--code-identical <ref>` is the oracle proving a sweep touched no executable line; `--rules-mode <hostRoot>` scans a host's generated rules layer as `/spec:doctor`'s new check 16, Rules-layer narration, with `--fix` patches at the repair-mode bar (before → after: the note rewritten as tag + rule + one owner citation). The five convention homes that mandated "why (dated incident)" in every header (`.claude/rules/conventions/scripts.md`, `.claude/rules/conventions/tests.md`, `.claude/rules/spec-pipeline.md`, `.claude/agents/gate-scripts.md`, `.claude/agents/plugin-tests.md`) move together to one wording: cite the owner id — spec path, AC-ID, D-number, ADR, run id, pin id — never dates, people, hosts, versions, or prior behavior.
